title: ghost bus
pitch: drive the last bus through a haunted town. draw the route, pick up the ghosts, drop them home before dawn. the divorced couple won't ride together and the vampire can smell the garlic chef.
how_to: drag from the bus along the streets to draw its route, then press go. ghosts board at their stop and get off at theirs.
the bus has only so many seats. drive past a waiting ghost you can't take and they go grumpy.
you can't draw past the dawn bar. three stars: everyone home, at or under par, and nobody grumpy.
each neighbourhood adds a rule: feuding ghosts, one-way streets and rickety bridges, then sleepy ghosts who only board after a honk.
controls: drag from the bus along the streets to draw its route (or tap a corner to drive there), then press go. undo and clear fix mistakes. keyboard: arrow keys draw, backspace undoes, enter drives, r clears, ? for a hint, m = sound, p = pause.
